notes: The System Health card no longer shows stale watchdog history. Its Watchdog row always displayed the very last line of the watchdog's log, however old - which is how a premature 'Gmail MCP STILL DOWN after restart' from July 26 sat on the dashboard for 16 days looking like a live outage. The event line now only appears while it is fresh (within 48 hours). Nothing is lost when something really breaks: during an outage the watchdog logs every couple of minutes, so the line is always current exactly when you need it. The watchdog script itself was also taught to log a 'back UP' line when a service recovers, and to give a restarted app up to 30 seconds to come up before declaring it still down.
